description:
Use this when the user wants their posting queue times changed: "post at 6pm on weekdays", "clear my queue
times". It replaces the old list, so call get_queue_times first and include the times to keep.
Not for: scheduling a post (update_draft) or choosing times from results (best_time_to_post). Free. It only
saves the times; nothing is posted.

slots.description: The whole new list, up to 70. Each has day (Monday to Sunday, daily, weekdays or weekends) and time (18:30 or 6:30pm, user local time). Empty list clears the queue.

name: set_queue_times
title: Set queue times
